name: Cordon of Arrows

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

targets.description: up to four nonmagical arrows or bolts, planted in the ground

upcast.text: You can plant two more pieces of ammunition for each slot level above 2.

summary: Plant up to four arrows or bolts that shoot creatures coming within 30 ft: Dex save or 2d4 Piercing each.
text: You touch up to four nonmagical arrows or bolts and plant them in the ground; the ammunition can't be moved while the spell lasts. Whenever a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of the ammunition for the first time on a turn, or ends its turn there, one piece flies up and strikes at it. The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d4 Piercing damage on a failure, and that piece of ammunition is then destroyed. When you cast the spell you can name creatures the ammunition will ignore. The spell ends when no ammunition remains planted. Lasts 8 hours. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: you can plant two more pieces of ammunition for each slot level above 2.
